claims.claim: B has a watch or other time-keeping device (or otherwise has access to the current time)
claims.attribute: B possesses a means of knowing the time
claims.adjudication_reason: The question 'What time do you have?' carries a definite possessive presupposition that B has access to the current time via a watch, phone, or other time-keeping device. This is a structural presupposition embedded in the interrogative form, not an inference from context.
